headword: {風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}

definitions.explanation: A low, usually two-panel {屏風|びょうぶ} placed behind the {風炉|ふろ} (portable brazier) and tea utensils in the tea ceremony, marking off the host's working space.

⟦{茶席|ちゃせき}→茶席：29411_chaseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: A tea screen was set up at the tea gathering.

examples.japanese: {風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}める→引き締める：15264_hikishimeru⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
A specialized tea-ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧) screen, lower than an ordinary ⟦{屏風|びょうぶ}→屏風：06228_byoubu⟧, set behind the {風炉|ふろ} and utensils to define the host's space.
